plan.encoding: ASCII canonical TSV with final LF
plan.repeatable_tail: db2 TAB exact-catalog-name TAB exact-FDID LF; alphabetical names, unique IDs
plan.offmesh_connections: Field must be absent; even an empty offmesh selection is unsupported.
plan.component_scope: Exactly DB2, resident, no map-domain/offmesh/terrain/navigation/GT/cameras; explicit Linux build70450 product17 only

identities.plan: SHA-256 of the complete canonical TSV bytes
identities.source: SHA-256(forever-logical-collection-v1 NUL + build little-endian u32 + build key + CDN key + locale ASCII + ENCODING content key + ROOT content key)
identities.source_scope: authenticated logical collection; not physical archive availability, encryption-key discovery or a complete archive snapshot; every decoded read still requires complete content MD5; supplied keys do not change logical content identity; MD5 integrity is not a MAC or trusted provenance
identities.keys: Key names, values, counts, hashes and input paths are excluded from CLI JSON, plans, package context and manifests. The complete plan SHA-256 binds only the provided-salsa20-v1 capability, not the caller's key-list contents.
identities.schema_catalog: This profile binds its exact schema-catalog id in the complete canonical plan SHA-256; older profiles retain their own catalog identities and canonical plan bytes.

limits.db2_regular_sections: For catalog DB2 sources with more than one section, the existing bounded catalog reader admits 2..16 regular sections; ordinary selected sources use the strict catalog decoder. No rows or partial table are published.
limits.db2_string_validation: The existing catalog raw-source fallback for invalid UTF-8 still validates complete regular-string pointer/NUL framing and cumulative source-byte limits without returning decoded rows; all other validation errors remain fatal.
limits.full_source_decode: Every selected DB2 FDID uses the existing supplied-key full-file decode route and still requires complete content CKey MD5 validation. A missing or mismatched caller key remains fatal as local_store_no_verified_encoding; no partial table or encrypted-source omission is published.

resume: Explicit same-context only; verified sealed components skipped; the entire unfinished producer reruns and replays retained artifacts; complete output refuses writes; supplied keys are required for each client-side inspect/extract/resume invocation and remain protected from output writes; every unfinished acquired object must still match the same selected complete CKey; sealed producers are verified and skipped.

verification.db2: Complete bounded validation against the plan-bound wowdbdefs-70450-v1 catalog and exact selected name set; verify-links follows the same selected DB2-only package traversal. Verification checks offline artifacts and does not read keys.
verification.key_coverage: A public key list or a partial key match does not prove complete decryption; only successful full-frame decode and complete CKey validation for every selected DB2 source do.
not_claimed: all 1161 tables acquired by a selected plan
complete key coverage for every 70450 table or encoding
verification.metadata_preflight: Complete exact selected DB2 names, nonempty files<=16MiB, sum<=16GiB before first artifact payload hash/read/allocation; verify-links applies the same DB2-only package traversal; --keys is forbidden for verify and verify-links.

failure: Stable path-free code and component; incomplete outputs retained; no available-prefix, native, network, missing-file or encrypted-source fallback.

provided_keys.input: explicit regular file, final symlink and special file rejected; read once with metadata identity and extra-byte EOF check
provided_keys.record_format: forever-tact-keys TAB 1 LF; sorted unique lowercase hex16 u64 name TAB hex32 key LF
provided_keys.cipher: Salsa20/20 with 16-byte keys, nonce4/8 padded to8, frame-index little-endian XOR, initial block counter zero
provided_keys.frames: one E wrapper around N or strict Z only; mandatory complete content MD5 and encoded frame MD5 where framed
provided_keys.source_protection: canonical key-file source included in protected roots before output writes

failure_envelope: forever-product-v17 after valid plan admission; generic CLI/plan failures before admission retain forever-product-v1; all errors path-free and key-free
scope: Explicit Linux build70450 DB2-only target-catalog publication/recovery with caller-supplied provided-salsa20-v1 keys. No other components, standalone70450, native product, Windows, collision/VMaps, full-world or runtime acceptance.

legacy_preservation.global_SUPPORTED_CLIENTS: 70170,70205,70338 unchanged; 70450 remains absent and is available only through scoped Linux product admission

admission.metadata: admit_db2_70450: exact70450 typed bounded build metadata before bootstrap
admission.store: LocalStore::open_db2_70450_with_keys; same build70450 admission/bootstrap as v16 with the caller's Keyring
admission.raw_store_scope: authenticated generic FDID bytes, not component acceptance; product driver enforces exact target DB2 catalog
admission.platform: Linux only before client/key/output IO; key input is explicit
admission.package_context: 70450 admits only Linux DB2 mask 1 for v16/v17 and collision mask 16 for v15; the complete plan SHA-256 binds the exact revision
